GitUI/libgit2 could not resolve newly sandbox-owned repository paths under the command sandbox; the recorded suite ran with the approved unsandboxed command while target isolation remained workspace- and oracle-owned.
The retained executable acquisition time was not remeasured; 32 ms is warm offline executable hash verification only.
